result.description: Search the ELIXIR Bio.tools registry for bioinformatics software tools, databases, and web services. Bio.tools is the comprehensive registry of bioinformatics resources maintained by ELIXIR, containing 30,000+ entries. Returns tool names, descriptions, types, topics, and homepages. Use this to find software for specific bioinformatics tasks (e.g., 'sequence alignment', 'variant calling', 'protein structure prediction'). Example: search 'RNA-seq' to find RNA sequencing analysis tools.
result.name: BioTools_search

page.description: Page number for paginated results (1-based). Default: 1.

q.description: Free-text search query. Searches across tool names, descriptions, and topics. Examples: 'blast', 'RNA-seq analysis', 'protein folding', 'variant calling', 'metagenomics'.

size.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Default: 10.

result.description: Get comprehensive information about ViennaRNA – RNA structure prediction and analysis
result.name: get_viennarna_info

include_examples.description: Whether to include usage examples and quick start guide

result.description: Predict protein 3D structure from amino acid sequence using ESMFold (Meta's ESM-2 language model). Returns per-residue pLDDT confidence scores (0-1 scale, higher=better) and summary statistics. Also returns the predicted PDB coordinate text. Fast single-sequence prediction (no MSA needed). Best for sequences under 400 residues. No authentication required.
result.name: ESMFold_predict_structure

sequence.description: Protein amino acid sequence in single-letter code. Example: 'MVLSPADKTNVKAAWGKVGAHAGEYGAEALERMFLSFPTTKTYFPHFDLSH'. FASTA headers and whitespace are stripped. Max ~400 residues recommended for fast results.

spec.description: Simple keyword-based tool finder for discovering relevant tools using text matching
spec.name: Tool_Finder_Keyword

categories.description: Optional list of tool categories to filter by

description.description: The description of the tool capability required.

limit.description: The number of tools to retrieve (default: 10)

picked_tool_names.description: Pre-selected tool names to process. If provided, tool selection will skip these tools.

return_call_result.description: Whether to return both prompts and tool names. If false, returns only tool prompts.

return_schema.description: List of matching tools (name, description, parameter schema), ranked by keyword relevance.

test_examples.description: Find tools for analyzing gene expression data
